summary: Phase 2 chunk 2B+2C retest on PREVIEW (admin, sales). Backend: 16/16 pytest pass (/app/tests/kkt2bc/test_phase2bc_prefs_search.py). PATCH /api/auth/me/preferences works (light/night 200, Auto/auto/dark/''/LIGHT/{} → 422, unauth 401), GET /auth/me returns ui_theme, and the search receipts group works (prefix 'KKT/2526/', lowercase, trailing digits; ~80 ms round trip). Frontend: login renders in Light and Night from localStorage with no flash; the sidebar order, sub-items, collapse memory, company-switcher-slot and role filtering are correct; Ctrl+K palette groups and navigation work, data-search-ms is about 200 ms, and the no-match buttons work; the New menu has exactly 5 items and they open the existing flows; the journey buttons on booking, receipt and bill rows are present; at 390 px there is no horizontal scroll on 7 screens, the mobile-menu drawer works and there is no bottom bar; the page skeleton shows; charts and tooltips are themed in Night. 4 real bugs: (1) the THEME SWITCH NEVER SAVES TO THE SERVER: the api.js PATCH interceptor rejects the body because it has no 'version'. The 'Theme not saved — will retry' toast appears every time, and after a reload the server value (light) overrides the user's Night choice. (2) The search-pill click (desktop) and search-icon-mobile do NOT open the palette; only Ctrl+K works, so on phones there is no way to search. (3) The bill-row journey button shows 'No entries recorded yet.' for nearly every bill. (4) In the palette, typing a name such as 'Rah' pre-selects the 'Roznamcha (today)' action, so Enter opens Roznamcha instead of the customer.

minor.issue: Returns items:[] for almost all bills. demand.create audit rows are written with entity_type='booking' (32,175 rows) and not 'demand' (only 5 rows), and the demand number is only in after.demand_number. So the A2 bill journey (journey-btn-bill-*) is empty, e.g. DM-2627-14077 / id 8bda0c66-…

When q contains '/', the regex is unanchored and not case-insensitive-indexed, so it scans the whole collection (fine at the current volume). Digit-only q matches receipt numbers that END with those digits ('$' anchor), which is OK, but a phone search such as '94310' also runs the receipts query.

ui_bugs.issue: api.patch('/auth/me/preferences',{theme}) is rejected client-side with 'PATCH ... requires a version (optimistic concurrency)', so it never reaches the server (backend log shows no browser PATCH). Result: the toast 'Theme not saved — will retry' appears every time, the 30 s retry also fails, and after a reload reconcileTheme() applies the server's 'light', so the Night choice is lost. This is the core of feature 2. Fix: exempt '/auth/me/preferences' in the interceptor (or send it via a dedicated axios call or an opt-out flag). Do not add 'version' to the body: StrictModel would then return 422.

onClick runs document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'k',metaKey:true})) without bubbles:true, but usePaletteHooks listens on window, so the event never arrives and clicking does nothing. On a 390 px phone this means search is unreachable. Fix: window.dispatchEvent(new Event('kkt:open-palette')) (a listener already exists) or add bubbles:true.

Typing 'Rah' shows the Customers and Bookings groups first, but the pre-selected item is 'Roznamcha (today)' in Actions (a fuzzy R..a..h match), so pressing Enter opens Roznamcha instead of Rahul Malhotra. cmdk also re-orders the server receipt results. Exact queries such as 'BK-2526-2281' and 'KKT/2526/15125' select the right record first. Suggest shouldFilter={false}, or a value/keywords setup that keeps the server records ranked first.

/site-visits?new=1 lands on /leads?tab=visits with no create dialog open (Lead opens its dialog, Customer opens /customers/new). The brief says each item opens the existing create flow. Check whether the Book visit dialog should auto-open.

integration_issues.issue: journey-btn-bill-<demandNo> opens the panel but it shows 'No entries recorded yet.' because the backend audit rows for demands are keyed on the booking (see backend minor).

design_issues.screen: Night theme: selected chips and segments invert to a white background with dark text
issues: Booking wizard: the active step card 'Who' is white
Reports: the selected left-nav item 'Collections (Received)' / 'Demand vs Collection' and the 'FY' segment are white
Demands: the 'Raised on' segment is white
Journey panel: the selected entry chip is white
Booking/C360: the 'V9' unit chip is white. All are readable, but they look like glaring light-on-dark islands; a muted surface (e.g. a warm-200 night token or a gold tint) would suit Night better
They still use the browser's native date inputs (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn calendar (pre-existing, but very visible in Night)
The master list appears twice: the side list is stacked above the main content, which repeats the same sections
Admin sees 'Building trust, delivering homes', but sales@ sees 'Real estate ERP' (likely the site-settings read is permission-gated). This is a minor inconsistency

action_items: HIGH: Theme save. Exempt PATCH /auth/me/preferences from the 'requires a version' interceptor in frontend/src/lib/api.js, rebuild the frontend, then verify that clicking Night produces a 200 in the backend log and that Night survives a reload.
HIGH: In AppShell, make search-pill and search-icon-mobile open the palette (window.dispatchEvent(new Event('kkt:open-palette')) or KeyboardEvent with bubbles:true).
MEDIUM: In the palette, rank server records above the static Actions/Pages entries (Enter after 'Rah' currently opens Roznamcha).

MEDIUM: Make the bill journey useful. Query audit_logs where entity_type='booking' AND after.demand_number = <demand_number> (or write demand.create with entity_type='demand'), so journey-btn-bill-* shows the entries.
LOW: Night inverted selected chips (wizard step, reports nav, segments, V9 chip, journey chip) should use a muted night surface.
LOW: Decide whether Quick → Site visit should auto-open the Book visit dialog.
LOW: theme-light/theme-night testids are duplicated (top bar and user menu). Consider prefixing the menu copies (e.g. menu-theme-night) for strict-mode selectors.
critical_code_review_comments: theme.js save() swallows the real error: the catch hides the client-side interceptor rejection. Log err.message so this kind of bug shows up.
AppShell.jsx is 516 lines and growing (NAV, QUICK, CRUMB, TopBar, Sidebar in one file). Split TopBar/Sidebar out before it passes 700.
search.py receipts: re.escape(q.upper()) + '' when '/' is in q gives an unanchored regex. Consider anchoring with '^' when q starts with a letter (e.g. 'KKT/') so it can use the receipt_number index.

success_rate.frontend: ~80% (theme persistence, pill/mobile search and bill journey content failing; the rest pass)

seed_data_creation: None. No payments or bookings were created (forms only opened: 3-step booking wizard and Post payment drawer both render unchanged). Admin ui_theme was toggled through the API during testing and restored to 'light' (verified via GET /auth/me). sales@ theme was re-saved with its existing value.

After the fixes, re-check: theme-night click → backend log PATCH 200 and survives a reload; search-pill and search-icon-mobile open command-palette-input; 'Rah'+Enter goes to a customer.
rca of the issue: Theme: frontend/src/lib/api.js lines 102-111 reject any PATCH whose object body lacks 'version'. theme.js sends {theme} only, so the promise rejects before any network call and the catch shows the toast and schedules a retry that fails forever. Reproduce: log in, click theme-night, see the toast, reload, and the theme is back to light. Search pill: AppShell.jsx lines 363 and 379 dispatch a non-bubbling KeyboardEvent on document, while usePaletteHooks.js line 71 listens on window. Bill journey: propagation.py journey_entity queries entity_type='demand', but demand.create audit rows are written with entity_type='booking' (Mongo: 32,175 vs 5).
